# csv_response_headerless — csv decode, header absent, pagination.none
# Boots the csv_response scenario's headerless endpoint, runs one drain, and
# asserts the events JSONL and redacted trace JSONL match the golden. With no
# header row each CSV row decodes to a positional list; every row is one event.

exec skopos template show -o spec.yml csv_response_headerless
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- want_trace.jsonl --
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":1,"method":"GET","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1"},"response_body":"body 170 bytes, non-json","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/csv_response/absent"}
-- want_events.jsonl --
["evt-000001","2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","1"]
["evt-000002","2026-01-01T00:00:01Z","2"]
["evt-000003","2026-01-01T00:00:02Z","3"]
["evt-000004","2026-01-01T00:00:03Z","4"]
["evt-000005","2026-01-01T00:00:04Z","5"]
